subject: Request: Accelerator slate carveout & pricing concession — VP/CFO endorsement required
messages:
From: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@asterbio.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Question on accelerator pricing for pilot

Rishi —

Appreciate the demo today. Short follow up from procurement: our pilot spans three teams and will hit ~2.2M tokens / month initially (projected to double in Q2). Options from our finance team show we need a blended unit cost that’s ~26% below your published commercial starter tier to make the internal business case.

We realize that’s outside standard packaging. If Redwood can provide a one-time accelerator carveout (12‑month pilot, 20% upfront commitment, optional extension), we can move to an enterprise PO and commit to an annualized expansion.

Can you confirm whether a concession at that level is something you can authorize, and what approvals are required? We’d like to close procurement and start on SOW signatures this month.

— Ben
Procurement Manager, AsterBio

---
Attachments: None
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Question on accelerator pricing for pilot

Team — looping you in. AsterBio is asking for a ~26% blended concession versus our starter tier for a 12‑month pilot that they say will start at ~2.2M tokens/mo and likely double after Q2 with a firm PO if pilot succeeds. They’re offering a 20% upfront commit and a strong case for expansion.

Key points I need covered for VP/CFO sign‑off memo:
- Revenue impact (model attached) and gross margin delta at the requested concession
- Recommended guardrails (minimum commit, overage pricing, termination/extension language)
- Any downstream product or support commitments (we will need to cap dedicated engineering time)

I’ve attached the quick numbers from the call (see pricing_impact_model_asterbio.xlsx). My ask: can we get a one‑page exec memo + recommended approval path by EOD Wednesday so I can present to the CFO? If approval requires a signed legal redline, flag that as well.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the external ask and keep it tight.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_impact_model_asterbio.xlsx
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-17T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Question on accelerator pricing for pilot

Rishi — reviewed the model and ran sensitivity scenarios. High level:

- At the requested 26% concession the near‑term gross margin on the pilot drops ~18 percentage points vs standard starter pricing (worst case if usage stays lower).
- With their 20% upfront commitment and an automatic conversion clause contingent on hitting the doubled volume in Q2, the 12‑month LTV crosses our mid‑tier threshold after month 6.
- Key recs for approval: require a minimum 20% upfront non‑refundable credit, 3x overage multiplier for usage beyond the committed floor, and inclusion of a 6‑month automatic review with ability to reset pricing.

I drafted a one‑page memo for VP/CFO signoff and attached the recommended term language for Legal to review. If Kimberly wants to escalate, we can recommend conditional approval with the above guardrails.

— Marissa
Revenue Ops Manager, Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_impact_model_asterbio.xlsx, redline_term_sheet.pdf
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-17T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Question on accelerator pricing for pilot

Rishi / Marissa — thank you for the analysis. I’m open to a targeted concession if we lock the commitment mechanics tightly. My initial position:

1) Approve up to 22% concession for a 12‑month pilot if the customer signs a PO with the 20% upfront non‑refundable payment and a clear expansion trigger (doubling to ~4.4M tokens/mo by June 2027).
2) Approvals above 22% require CFO+VP Commercial signoff (i.e., my sign + VP).
3) Legal must insert a rollback clause (pricing reverts to standard if trigger not met) and a cap on engineering SLA support (no more than 20 hours over pilot unless pre‑paid).

If Rishi believes the commercial risk still warrants a deeper concession (26% requested), bring the ask with the signed PO and an explicit extension clause; I’ll review with the CEO/CFO for exception.

Kimberly Park
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@asterbio.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T14:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Question on accelerator pricing for pilot — proposed path forward

Ben — thanks for the patience while we reviewed internally. Summary and next steps:

- We can offer a concession framework for the 12‑month pilot. Conditional approval up to 22% off starter tier pending receipt of a PO with 20% non‑refundable upfront payment and explicit expansion trigger to ~4.4M tokens/mo by June 30, 2027.
- If AsterBio needs the full 26% concession, we’ll require the signed PO and an extension-to-enterprise clause; that escalates to CFO+CEO for final approval.
- Legal will send a short addendum capturing the rollback clause and engineering support cap (20 hours unless pre‑paid).

If that structure works, please send the PO to procurement@redwood.ai this week and we’ll queue the addendum for signature. I’ll mark the deal as 'conditional approval — finance guardrails applied' in HubSpot (link below).

Best —
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
